summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K incorporating a press release announcing clinical program updates at ICNMD 2026. The release details poster and showcase presentations on SAT-3247, an investigational oral small molecule for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including six-month follow-up data from Phase 1b and ongoing Phase 2 trials. No special-situation event—such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change—is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing a clinical update and contains no corporate transaction or structural change.
